mechanism: Gemfibrozil inhibits CYP3A4 and may increase lisdexamfetamine metabolism complications; amphetamines increase cardiovascular stress which may be compounded in patients on gemfibrozil (typically those with lipid disorders and underlying cardiovascular risk).
action: Monitor for increased amphetamine effects and cardiovascular symptoms; consider alternative lipid-lowering agent if possible, or ensure close cardiovascular monitoring if combination is necessary.
